dct_title_s: Totius Regni Hungariæ : maximæque partis Danubii Fluminis una cum adjacentibus et finitimis regionibus
dct_alternative_sm: Totius Regni Hungariæ : maxim æ que partis Danubii Fluminis una cum adjacentibus et finitimis regionibus
dct_description_sm: 2 bar scales on map, given in “Milliaria Germanica communia” and “Milliaria Hungaria communia.”
Latitudinal and longitudinal lines along margin.
Decorative cartouche (with figures), compass roses, ships.
Appears in Theatrum Europaeum, oder außführliche und warhafftige Beschreibung ..., Frankfurt am Main, 1672.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 35.
Evidence of conservation repair joining the 2 sheets; registration slightly off.
